definitions.name: bs721_launchparty_msg_ExecuteMsg
definitions.description: Possible state-changing messages that the launchparty-fixed contract can handle.

mint.description: Allows to mint a bs721 token and, optionally, to refer an address.

amount.description:
Amount of token to mint. The maximum number an address can mint can be limited by the field
`maximum_per_address` defined in the `Config`.

set_nft_address.description: Allows us to set the nft contract being used. Primary use for integration tests
